title: Bin bắn bi ở sân đình
hook: Bin THUA sạch bi ở sân đình!

scenes.text: Bin ôm túi bi, chạy ra sân đình thi bắn với bạn.
images: {BIN} running toward a village communal house courtyard, marbles in his hands, 1990s Vietnamese countryside, bright warm daylight
{BIN} and {BANBE} crouching on packed earth near a banyan tree, colorful glass marbles scattered, old brick communal house in the background, cheerful expressions, no text
scenes.motion: Bin runs fast, squats down, and carefully lines up his marble.

scenes.text: Bin búng mạnh quá, bi văng xuống rãnh, cả đám cười khúc khích.
images: {BIN} kneeling in surprise, watching a marble roll into a narrow ditch, {BANBE} laughing beside him, village courtyard details, warm sunlight
{BIN} reaching into a small muddy ditch with a determined face, marbles and chalk circle on the ground, 1990s rural Vietnam, cute humorous mood
scenes.motion: Bin flinches, then leans forward and peeks into the ditch.

scenes.text: Bin phụng phịu vì mất bi, bụng đói mà chưa tới bữa.
images: {BIN} sitting on the ground with puffed cheeks, holding an empty pouch, village đình courtyard, soft warm light, playful sadness
{BIN} looking at his stomach, a few marbles in the dust, old tiled-roof communal house, nostalgic countryside setting
scenes.motion: Bin pouts and rubs his tummy, looking both sad and hungry.

scenes.speaker: ong
scenes.text: Mất bi thì nhặt lại, thua thì mai bắn tiếp, cháu ạ.
images: {ONG} smiling kindly and handing a small handful of marbles to {BIN}, old farmer clothes, village communal house courtyard, warm bright afternoon
{ONG} crouching beside {BIN} and pointing at the chalk circle on the ground, gentle teasing smile, no text
scenes.motion: Ong crouches down and places the marbles back into Bin’s palm.

scenes.text: Bin cười tít mắt, ôm ông, rồi được thưởng thêm chiếc kẹo lạc.
images: {BIN} hugging {ONG} tightly, both smiling in the courtyard, marbles still on the ground, 1990s Vietnamese village atmosphere
{BIN} happily biting a peanut candy while {ONG} chuckles, sunlit communal house yard, cozy and heartwarming
scenes.motion: Bin hugs ông tightly, then munches the candy with sparkling eyes.

scenes.text: Nhà bạn có từng bắn bi ở sân đình như Bin không?
images: {BIN} waving excitedly with marbles in hand, village communal house courtyard, inviting friendly mood
{BIN} and {BANBE} sitting on the ground, ready for another marble game, bright nostalgic countryside scene
scenes.motion: Bin waves at the viewer and invites them to share memories.

caption: Tuổi thơ ở sân đình luôn có tiếng bi lách cách và vài cú búng “đi lạc” 😂 Bạn có từng thua sạch bi như Bin chưa?
